name: UCLA automated protein crystallization facility (NIH S10, Formulatrix/Tecan, mosquito, Rock Imager; 2007)
brief: A new campus macromolecular crystallization facility for structural biology: an automated liquid handler builds crystallization screening reagents, a nanolitre dispensing robot sets up sitting-drop crystallization trials, and an automated imaging microscope stores and images the plates to score crystal growth.

cost.excludes_note: Award amount of an NIH Shared Instrumentation grant, i.e. the equipment funds requested/awarded, not a vendor invoice; any institutional co-funding is not stated. Facility room renovation and manager salary are explicitly provided separately by UCLA and are excluded. 2007 dollars.

notes: price_basis=configured, set from the source wording (S10 award for a complete crystallisation system) before base/configured catalog prices were researched. Three-instrument crystallisation suite. Weak like-for-like: 2007 dollars (no inflation adjustment in the cost model) and the Tecan EVO 150 is costed as the newer Tecan Fluent; mosquito and Rock Imager are older model generations. Verified 3 Oct 2026 via NIH RePORTER API (project 1S10RR023543-01, FY2007, award_amount 375141). Abstract quote: "The system will consist of (1) a Formulatrix Tecan Evo-150 liquid handling robot for the generation of screening reagents; (2) a Mosquito nanoliter dispensing robot for setting up crystallization trials; and (3) a Formulatrix Rock Imager automated microscope for rapidly imaging the trial results." Source gives NO per-item prices, only the total award. Mapping: 3 of 3 items by count; 2/3 exact (mosquito -> sptlabtech_mosquito_xtal3, Rock Imager -> formulatrix_rock_imager_1000), the Tecan Freedom EVO 150 is the predecessor of the catalog's Fluent 780 (closest equivalent, not identical). Catalog prices are current (2020s) whereas this is a 2007 purchase, so expect the prediction to be higher in real terms; adjust for inflation/tech generation before judging. Equipment value share unknown (no item prices).
